verdictScope: This candidate as an executable reference runtime at fa3985b. Not V1 authority, not a clinical or sporting validation.
verdictBasis: Two BLOCKING findings. QRE-V1CP-01: on the default path a head-impact break reason with a structured nonclinical category now screens NONCLINICAL and applies a nonclinical return without any question (FREEZE-6 asked); the lexicon goes beyond the SSCTR-approved closed list. QRE-V1CP-02: after a clinical hold raised inside a Situation 1 window, the readiness restart (S6, MODERATE floor) is replaced by the stale Situation 1 ladder from the pre-window doses (RC-04, Q07). Six MAJOR findings and four MINOR ones follow; test adequacy is MAJOR (9 non-equivalent surviving mutants).

regression.defaultPathConclusion: On the spent corpora the default path (no coaching key, no F08 event) is byte-identical to FREEZE-6 apart from the 13 disclosed steps and the H05 s5 carry-over; 12 of the 13 are approved Block 1 decisions, H20 s1-s2 is not. Outside the corpus the A1 widening changes default-path behaviour in a fail-open direction (QRE-V1CP-01).

fuzz.method: Seeded random timelines (400 seeds, 9,684 steps) on the 8-week hybrid fixture, 40% with a 10K race: weekly reviews with and without checks, NOT_FEELING_100 (every condition, allowed intents, 3-14 days, speeds, sports, regions, 5% with a sign yes), WELLBEING_CHECK, READINESS_DECLARATION (sports, restrictions, speeds), RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE (nonclinical and ILLNESS), SCHEDULE_CHANGE, UNAVAILABLE_DAY, PREFERENCE_CHANGE, EVENT_DATE_CHANGE; 10% adverse and 8% unreported sessions. Each review evaluated twice; 35% replayed after adoption.
fuzz.limits: The invariants checked D49 only inside ladder weeks (QRE-V1CP-05 sits at the exit) and the clinical hold only until a readiness declaration (QRE-V1CP-02 sits after it); both were found by directed scenarios.

findings.title: A1 lexicon wider than the SSCTR-approved closed list: head-impact and care-place texts screen NONCLINICAL on the default path
location: CoachingCore/src/r6-clinical.mjs:64-77 (BACK_PREV, BACK_NEXT, HEAD_NEXT, nonBodyUse)
CoachingCore/src/r6-clinical.mjs:73 ("head" ignores the possessive rule the comment at :60-62 states)
CoachingCore/src/r6-clinical.mjs:79 (idiomAllowed blocks only damage verbs and clinical words)
findings.failureScenario: RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE, break week 2 Tue-Sun, interruption {reasonCategory:"WORK", nonclinical:true, reason:"banged my head into the door frame"} (same for "knocked my head into a beam at work", "back at the clinic again", "was back in the er", "back in a brace for two weeks", "back in bed for days", "head over the handlebars at the trip"). FREEZE-6: ASK, reason unclear. Candidate: screen NONCLINICAL_CATEGORY, decision MODIFY REESTABLISH "short nonclinical interruption (6 days): resume the last completed doses", no question.
findings.expected: Q01(c) approves only "back from, came/got/went/flew/drove back, back home, back to, be back" and "on my/our/his/her feet"; C-Q01-2 makes the lexicon closed and versioned; the re-review trigger is any lexicon change; free text may only add CLINICAL or ASK. A body word outside the approved idioms stays ambiguous and is asked once (interruption.clinicalReason).
findings.rawEvidence: Probe on screenInterruptionReason, base vs candidate, category WORK, 25 texts: 10 change from ASK to NONCLINICAL, and only one of them ("on my feet") rests on an approved idiom; "hit my head on the cabinet", "fell and hit my head into the wall" and "came back with a sore back" stay ASK; every clinical-word text stays CLINICAL. End to end via evaluateProgram on three of them: base ASK x3, candidate MODIFY REESTABLISH x3.
findings.alsoAffects: Regression check: R7D-H20 s1-s2 rely on "back on Wednesday", outside the approved list.

escalation.why: Lexicon content is SSCTR boundary content (Q01, re-review trigger); task contract ESCALATE_IF "a relevant sign being ignored".

findings.fixScope: Narrow, runtime-only: restrict the collocation and idiom sets to the approved list, apply the determiner/possessive rule to every body word, and add negative directed tests (impact texts with a structured category stay ASK).

findings.title: A superseded Situation 1 episode stays open in its superseding week and comes back over a readiness restart or a declared break's return
location: CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs:1310 (endF08Marks keeps this week's markers with endDate the day before, even below their startDate)
CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs:1072-1074 (marksOf/openEpisode count any marker, empty-range ones included)
callers CoachingCore/src/r6-adaptation.mjs:1399 (readinessRestart) and :2446 (returnAfterPause)
findings.failureScenario: A (clinical): MILD_ILLNESS, REST, 5-day window from week 1 Tue; week 1 Thu WELLBEING_CHECK with feverOrChills yes -> CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; week 2 Tue 07:00 READINESS_DECLARATION, all signs no, both sports ready -> READINESS_RESTART (week 3 runs 15/15/20, RETURN mode, entry held in week 4). The truncated WAIT marker (2026-11-23..2026-11-23) keeps the episode open: the week-2 weekly review refuses the S6 check (W1-W9, X1-X4) and asks the Situation 1 window-end items W10-W15 and improved. Answered with improved true, the S1 ladder R2, R3, R4 is placed from week 3 with FIXED pre-window starts over the restart: week 3 runs 35/35/35 (S6: 15/15/20), week 5 35/35/50 (S6: 25/25/35), run mode EASY instead of RETURN; the restart's RETURN_HOLD starts stay on weeks 3-4 but the ladder's FIXED starts, placed after them, override them. B (declared break): NEED_REST REST 3-day window; week 2 Mon RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE (travel Fri-Sun) -> REESTABLISH; the week-2 weekly review then asks the Situation 1 window-end check, and improved true places R2, R3, R4 over the declared return.
findings.expected: RC-04: after an S3 exit a later no never returns the episode to Situation 1; Q07: MODERATE is the floor after a clinical hold; I-15 / endF08Marks: the restart or the declared return ends the episode from its week; RC-07: never converted.
findings.rawEvidence: Directed scenario on the candidate; M11 (endF08Marks no-op) also survives the suite (QRE-V1CP-09).

escalation.why: Runtime defect; SSCTR informed through this record (RC-04, Q07).

findings.fixScope: Narrow, runtime-only: remove (or flag ended) the episode's markers in the superseding week and exclude superseded episodes in openEpisode/f08Guard; directed tests for both callers.

mutationMethod.base: A pristine copy of src/, the policy and review files it reads, the harness lib, the final2 holdout file and the v1cp test files, in a new scratch directory outside the repository (src byte-identical to the worktree: 0 hash mismatches); control run 43/43 pass.
mutationMethod.perMutant: A fresh copy per mutant, one targeted edit (applied only when its text occurs exactly as declared), then node --test on the five v1cp test files (43 tests).
mutationMethod.notRun: The 1,015 legacy tests were not run per mutant: they create no F08 markers or facts, so they cannot observe these edits.
mutationMethod.survivorChecks: Each survivor was run on a scenario on the pristine copy and on the mutant; a difference shows it is not equivalent.
